data.name: Abdus
data.gender_notes: Abdus is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Abd’, meaning ‘to serve’ or ‘slave’, Abdus is a name that signifies the ultimate servitude and devotion to Allah. This name is a reminder of our purpose in life as Muslims, which is to worship and serve our Creator. The name Abdus carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abdus usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes submission and servitude to Allah.
data.etymology: Abdus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdus total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
